title: Crying men
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why are men sometimes judged differently from women when they cry?
Can crying be a sign of strength rather than weakness?
In which situations do you think people feel pressure to hide their emotions?
Would society benefit if men were encouraged to express sadness more openly?
How would you react if your manager cried during a stressful situation at work?
